rejected_scratch_transcription.disposition: The enlarged scan shows five coordinates. The extra D was a temporary manual-transcription error, not a historical source character. No source deletion, 273-slot source model or deletion-fit result is retained as evidence.

context_records_excluded_from_new_counts.relation: Source-labeled B1 of the same three-part message. Its prior missing 20-coordinate reconstruction and three unknown unit digits remain separate and unchanged. B2/B3 do not determine that block or those digits.

Different instruction with related raw name/place strings. The earlier HPTMANNSTAEDT string permits a different title/name segmentation from new HPTMXMANNSTAEDT. No same-person identity, exact-copy relation or change to its 2048 alternatives is inferred.

prior_attribution_check.scope: Bounded explicit-reference and body check; no first historical decipherment claim.

paper.title: Deciphering ADFGVX messages from the Eastern Front of World War I
paper.explicit_prior_p175_body: Discusses p175 A at 22:57 together with p172 C, von Weiher and delegation travel through Spa to Berlin. That body and historical interpretation have prior credit.
paper.schedule_limit: The narrative gives Berlin arrival at 15:00 on 11 November. This edition retains raw ?X03 NACHM with FD in56789 and does not import the narrative time, regiment identity or asserted sequence after signing.

dissertation.author: George Lasry
dissertation.result: Repeats the p172 C / p175 A discussion. No separate explicit p176 B2/B3 body was found by the bounded name/token search.

comments.result: The p176 missing 10-coordinate discussion concerns a separate A-family breakthrough message. No explicit B2/B3 body was located in this bounded check.

earlier_repository_candidates.new_contribution: Source-exact transcripts, complete position/domain and coordinate repair ledgers, native-frame verification and explicit uncertainty. The four bodies already had unreviewed corpus-screen candidates; p175 additionally has explicit prior published discussion.

literal_limits: p175 A1 retains EXIX2 and HPTMXMANNSTAEDT without new military or biographical identification.
p175 A2 retains 11X11, ?X03 and OHLRM4B. The unknown is a square-cell domain, not an erased source coordinate.
p176 B2 retains BESATZUNSHEER, FEINDVORFUEHLTE and SAMVIT exactly; no extra G, word movement or place normalization is inserted.
p176 B3 retains MAROKANERN, SISTOW, RUSTUK, RUMAENISCHUFER and SLOBOZIE. Its assertions are a contemporary report, not independent verification of troop movements.
Shared geography with the Nov9 and Nov3 military reports is not evidence of identical plaintext.
